## Plan + test matrix

The defect (F-519): the materializer's `read_claim_groups` never read
`valid_period` bounds or `claim_directness`, so Phase 1.2's valid-time filter
was vacuous on the materialized path (the API compute-on-read path already
read them — the two surfaces diverged); a connector's *declared* per-claim
directness (e.g. the ADR-122 `D6` non-probative stamp) was ignored in favour
of the bare genre × predicate matrix; and within-tolerance pooled
disagreements recorded no dissent at all (0 `dissenting_claims`,
`agreement=UNCONTESTED`, `state=uncontested`).

1. **`reconcile/resolve.py`** — `Claim` gains `declared_directness`
   (connector-declared only; the `connector_default_D2` sink default is
   *absence* of declaration, distinguished via `assertion_map_basis`).
   Effective D = the weaker of (declared, matrix) — a connector may declare a
   claim *less* probative than the matrix row (it knows how it observed), and
   may never self-strengthen beyond it (the ruleset caps — "declared D unless
   the ruleset overrides", read fail-closed). Labels: `SIG-EPIS-017:*`.
   Phase 1.2's valid-time exclusion now fires `SIG-RECON-006:1.2`.
   `digest_token` covers valid bounds + declared D (SIG-RECON-020: every
   decision input moves the input digest).
2. **Tolerance-aware dissent** — within-`value_tolerance` pooled members whose
   values differ from the winner's are recorded as `contested_claim_ids`, join
   `dissenting_claim_ids` (they assert a different literal value), and lift
   agreement to `MINOR_DISAGREEMENT` (the established "dissent within
   tolerance" level — `web/src/lib/epistemic.ts`); `contested`-at-most, never
   IRRECONCILABLE from pool-internal jitter. State stays `uncontested` — a
   within-tolerance disagreement is disclosed dissent, NOT a contradiction
   (no `resolved_conflict` → no `value_disagreement` entity minted).
3. **`reconcile/materialize.py`** — `read_claim_groups` reads
   `lower/upper(valid_period)`, `claim_directness`, `assertion_map_basis`;
   `resolution_row` persists the contested signal in `evidence_counts`;
   `rematerialize_report` = the read-only before/after state-distribution
   diff with per-pair delta classes (the queued leg's dry-run artifact).
4. **`api/store_pg.py`** — `claims_for` + `_public_claim_groups` gain
   `claim_directness` + `assertion_map_basis` so compute-on-read resolves on
   the same truthful inputs (`claim_lineage` stays unjoined there —
   `sig_read_public` deliberately has no grant, declared_lineage.sql:144).
5. `RESOLVER_VERSION` → `p08.1/1.2.0`; `l3_rebuild_sample.json` repinned via
   `docs/build/tools/gen_l3_sample.py`.

## Implementation notes

- **`resolve.py`**: `Claim` gains `valid_from`/`valid_to` (the declared
  `valid_period` bounds) and `declared_directness` — resolved by the new
  module-level `declared_directness(claim_directness, assertion_map_basis)`,
  which returns `None` (= undeclared) for the `connector_default_D2` basis
  marker, a `legacy_synthetic`/NULL basis holding the schema `D2`, and a
  missing column value. `_effective_directness` = the WEAKER of declared vs
  matrix: declared-weaker fires `SIG-EPIS-017:declared_directness=<D>` and
  stands (a declared `D6` drops the claim as `connector-declared D6
  non-probative`); declared-stronger fires
  `SIG-EPIS-017:matrix_caps_declared=<D>` and the matrix caps. Phase 1.2's
  overlap test now fires `SIG-RECON-006:1.2` and drops with
  `valid_period does not intersect as_of_world`. An unparseable declared
  value can never strengthen — it is capped to the matrix (`_D_RANK.get`
  defaults the rank to 0, below every matrix rank → the cap branch).
- **Tolerance-aware dissent**: `_pool_within_tolerance` pools as before;
  each `Candidate` gains `contested_claim_ids` — pool members whose literal
  `value` differs from the representative's (sorted, deterministic). With
  no second candidate, agreement lifts to `MINOR_DISAGREEMENT` and
  `SIG-RECON-053:contested` fires; the contested ids join the resolution's
  `dissenting_claim_ids` (they assert a different literal value) while
  staying in `supporting_claim_ids` (within tolerance IS agreement).
  `_contradiction_state` takes `dissent=`candidate-level-disagreement —
  a contested-only winner is `uncontested`, never `resolved_conflict`, and
  no `value_disagreement` entity is minted. `RESOLVER_VERSION` →
  `p08.1/1.2.0`.
- **`digest_token`**: both arms (content-hash and full-payload) now carry
  `valid_from|valid_to|declared_directness` — a re-perioded or re-graded
  claim is a different decision input, so the digest moves and the
  superseding resolution lands append-only (SIG-RECON-020).
- **`rationale.py` + `ruleset.toml`**: `RESOLVED_CONTENDED_TOLERANCE`
  template ("{n_contested} further claim(s) differ within the declared
  tolerance …") selected when the winner has contested members and no
  second candidate; `n_contested` added to the fill map and to
  `REPRESENTATIVE_FILL` (SIG-RECON-023 clause checks stay green);
  `ruleset_version` → `2026.3`.
- **`materialize.py`**: `read_claim_groups` selects `lower/upper(
  c.valid_period)`, `c.claim_directness`, `c.assertion_map_basis` and hands
  them to `Claim`; `resolution_row` persists `n_contested` +
  `contested_claim_ids` in `evidence_counts`. `rematerialize_report` is
  the READ-ONLY dry-run: same reader, same `RESOLVE` call, diffed against
  the current materialized rows (`input_digest IS NOT NULL`, `upper_inf(sys_period)`)
  — digest-equal pairs are `unchanged`, changed pairs are `PairDelta`s
  classified by `classify_pair_delta` into the closed `DELTA_CLASSES`
  vocabulary (`new-resolution`, `temporal-deconflicted`,
  `directness-reweighted`, `contested-disclosed`, `tolerance-de-escalated`,
  `escalated-conflict`, `conflict-reclassified`, `state-shift`,
  `value-revised`, `other-input-change`). `rematerialize-report` CLI verb
  prints it; `rematerialize_report_from_dsn` is the runner seam. Writes
  nothing.
- **`api/store_pg.py`**: `claims_for` and `_public_claim_groups` select +
  construct the same truthful fields (26/27-column tuples extended in
  order); `declared_directness(...)` is shared with the materializer so
  the two read surfaces cannot diverge. `claim_lineage` stays unjoined in
  the public path (`sig_read_public` has no grant — deliberate).
- **Sample**: `docs/build/tools/gen_l3_sample.py` pins the new fields
  (null in the sample) + the version notes; `l3_rebuild_sample.json`
  repinned; `rebuild.load_sample()` verifies byte-identical.
- **Tests**: `tests/reconcile/test_input_truth.py` — 18 unit tests covering
  every matrix row (valid-time overlap/non-overlap, declared D6/weaker/
  capped/defaulted, within-/beyond-tolerance, no-tolerance default, mirror
  agreement/disagreement, exactly four states, digest movement, every
  delta class + the closed vocabulary). `tests/db/test_resolver_input_truth.py`
  — 7 DB tests over the real testcontainer spine: reader truth (bounds +
  declared-vs-defaulted D), the API reader's identical inputs, contested
  persistence on the `resolution` row (`dissenting_claims` +
  `evidence_counts.contested_claim_ids`), report delta classes on
  fabricated pre-P35.27 materialized rows, read-only + idempotent `+0` /
  `skipped_existing`. Two pre-existing assertions updated in
  `test_camera_predicates.py` (the absorbed-dissent and U4 dissenting sets)
  to assert the disclosed-dissent behaviour; the `_row` stub gains the four
  trailing P35.27 columns.

- **Pass 1 (mechanical)** — `ruff check` clean; `ruff format` applied;
  `mypy` 367 files clean; `pytest tests/reconcile` 238/238;
  `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1 pytest tests/db/test_resolver_input_truth.py`
  7/7; `make test-db` 692/692; `check_live_claims corpus` 0 violations
  (the two crashed-worker lines that asserted `live`/`hosted` without a
  same-segment negation reworded). JSON round-trip: `resolution_row`'s
  `evidence_counts` serialises `contested_claim_ids` to JSONB; the
  `rematerialize_report` diff reads `value_num` as Decimal→float so the
  before/after comparison meets resolver floats on equal terms.
- **Pass 2 (semantic)** — audited every clause of the contract against the
  diff: (a) valid-time reads flow through `read_claim_groups` AND both API
  readers — Phase 1.2 is no longer vacuous on the materialized path; (b) a
  defaulted `D2` is absence-of-declaration via the basis marker — verified
  against `db/src/db/assertion.py` (`defaulted["claim_directness"] =
  "connector_default_D2"` is the only marker the sink records); (c)
  contested is persisted AND disclosed (`dissenting_claims` column +
  `evidence_counts.contested_claim_ids` + `MINOR_DISAGREEMENT` +
  `SIG-RECON-053:contested` in `rules_fired`); (d) `contested` appears in
  `agreement`'s vocabulary and `contested_claim_ids`, never in
  `contradiction_state` — the four-state pin is asserted end-to-end;
  (e) `rematerialize_report` writes nothing (verified by row-count
  invariance in the DB test) and names every delta class.
- **Pass-2 catch fixed**: `render_rationale`'s `contested_only` branch
  lacked a `status == "RESOLVED"` guard — an UNRESOLVED outcome with
  contested members (a pooled, too-weak pair → U1) would have carried the
  `RESOLVED_CONTENDED_TOLERANCE` template asserting a value never
  resolved. Guard added;
  `test_unresolved_with_contested_keeps_the_unresolved_rationale` pins it.
- **Known semantic choice**: a malformed declared directness (a value
  outside `D1..D6`) is treated as stronger-than-matrix and therefore
  capped to the matrix — it can neither crash `weight_class` (never
  reaches it) nor strengthen; it also cannot weaken. The DB CHECK
  (`claim_directness REFERENCES vocab_claim_directness`) bounds stored
  values to `D1..D6`, so this path is belt-and-braces for non-PG readers.
- **Two test edits to pre-existing assertions** are behaviour-contracted,
  not loosened: `test_values_within_tolerance_corroborate_one_observed_value`
  and `test_two_pools_beyond_tolerance_fire_the_absolute_u4` asserted the
  F-519 silent-absorption behaviour (`dissenting == ()`); they now assert
  the disclosed-dissent contract. No assertion was weakened — both gained
  coverage.
